ngaap.guidance: Calendar 2020 (initial): organic revenue up 5% - 7% from combined calendar 2019 revenue; GAAP EPS $8.35 - $8.75; non-GAAP EPS $11.35 - $11.75 (adds back merger integration costs ~0.72, amortization of acquisition-related intangibles ~3.17, inventory step-up ~0.06; tax ~(0.95)); operating cash flow $2.8 - $2.9 billion; capital expenditures ~$400 million; adjusted free cash flow $2.6 - $2.7 billion (adds back ~$200 million of integration cash costs).
ngaap.notes: Non-GAAP EPS and adjusted EBIT exclude amortization of acquisition-related intangibles, L3Harris merger transaction and integration costs, facility consolidation charges, the inventory fair-value step-up, the pension curtailment gain, the lease adjustment, gains on the Night Vision and asset-group sales and debt refinancing losses; adjusted EBIT still includes non-operating pension income (other than the curtailment gain). Zero-value pro forma rows (pre-merger L3, impact of L3 diluted shares, divested businesses) are dropped from the bridges. Adjusted free cash flow = operating cash flow - net capex + cash used for merger transaction and integration costs + voluntary pension contribution. Quarter column: no combined adjustments apply (margin denominator = reported revenue 4,832). Pro forma / combined tables exist in this release and are NOT used: the "Calendar Year Ended" columns (CY19 includes pre-merger L3 for the first half in the non-GAAP tables), all prior-year "combined" columns (L3 + Harris) and the combined segment tables in the release text.

notes: is.op_income is computed (sales - cogs - sga - other operating lines); the statement of income prints no operating income line. is.dps: computed: 10-KT two-quarter dividends $1.50 per share less $.75 in the first quarter (10-Q); not printed for the quarter. bs.tl is computed (total current liabilities + total non-current liabilities); not printed. cf.pension_contrib and cf.pension_income are as presented in the cash flow statement (pension income is a negative non-cash adjustment). is.nci is signed as a deduction (negative = loss attributable to noncontrolling interests added back). bs.st_debt = Short-term debt + Current portion of long-term debt (sum). cf.da = sum of the depreciation / amortization lines where split. cf.divest = sum of the proceeds-from-sale lines (businesses, discontinued operations, asset group, adjustments). Income statement and segments = quarter column of the February 2020 release. Cash flow = the six-month (two quarters ended 3-Jan-2020) statement from the 10-KT (ytd_months 6; identical to TP19); balance sheet = 10-KT at 3-Jan-2020. The release also prints a quarter cash flow (operating cash flow 858, net capex (89)), not recorded in the mapped keys. cf.acquisitions = +1,130 net cash ACQUIRED in the L3Harris merger (an inflow). extra.pension.non_service_fas_pension_income 92 is the segment-table "Pension adjustment" for the quarter; non-operating income 113 also includes the 23 pension curtailment gain. 14-week quarter (28-Sep-2019 to 3-Jan-2020).
